pages.text: $(li)$(item)Regulator$(): moves items from the back inventory to the front until it holds the filter amounts, then emits redstone $(li)$(item)Relay$(): 9 slots, accepts from every side but the front and keeps pushing out the front $(li)$(item)Buffer$(): 18 slots open on all sides; comparators read the fill level
$(li)$(item)Item Detector$(): pulses for every stack passing through
